plot: Plasma hijacks regional transport and habitat beacons to force migration and draw energy from displaced Pokemon.

stages.title: Battle Company
pages:
Receptionist: These shipments never
reached the towns on our invoices.
Someone replaced the destination
codes with old waterway numbers.

The crates held habitat beacons,
not supplies for Trainer battles.
A Plasma seal was hidden beneath
the transport company label.

Take this copy of the ledger.
The gallery has a map of the old 
waterways. Ask the curator beside 
the paintings to compare it.
stages.repeatText: The ledger points to old waterways.\nAsk the curator in the Art Gallery\f\nto compare its route numbers.
stages.blockedText:
You are following the missing cargo?
Start with the receptionist at 
the Battle Company. Follow each 
clue before bringing it here.

stages.title: Art Gallery
pages:
Curator: These numbers match the
canals beneath the old city!
This painting was made before
Castelia covered them with streets.

The marked channel joins a freight
tunnel beneath the sewers.
Someone has drawn sound beacons
at the locks along its course.
A musician at Cafe Sonata heard\nthe same three-note signal below\f\nthe street. Show him this map.
stages.repeatText: The freight channel begins beneath\nthe sewers. The musician at Cafe\f\nSonata can identify its signal.
stages.blockedText:
You are following the missing cargo?
Start with the receptionist at 
the Battle Company. Follow each 
clue before bringing it here.

stages.title: Cafe Sonata
pages: Musician: Low, high, then low...\nThat is what I heard through the\f\nfloorboards after closing time.

The wild Pokemon stopped calling
whenever that signal sounded.
Then they all moved toward the
same drain. Music should invite 
a response, not silence one!

I wrote the pattern on your map.
Fennel studies Pokemon dreams.
Her laboratory is in the building
opposite the Gym. Ask her about 
the strange mist near the drain.
stages.repeatText: Fennel can compare our three-note\nsignal with the mist in the drain.\r\nHer lab is opposite the Gym.
stages.blockedText:

stages.title: Fennel laboratory
pages:
Fennel: That rhythm matches the
electrical pulses in my readings!
Dream Mist carries them farther
than an ordinary radio signal.

Munna woke from the same nightmare
each time the pulse returned.
A dark shape stood at the edge
of its dream. Darkrai, perhaps... 
But a frightened dream is no proof.

Someone is using this mist to
drive Pokemon out of their homes.
A curious resident nearby found
a broken coil. Visit the apartment 
where the curiosee lives.
stages.repeatText: The curiosee found a damaged coil.\nCompare its markings with the\f\nledger before blaming any Pokemon.

stages.title: Curiosity apartment
pages:
Curiosee: Look what I found by
the drain! I check everything.
This coil is stamped with the
same number as your shipment.

Its label says: CORRIDOR CONTROL.
A second label says: ENERGY RETURN.
Those beacons herd Pokemon down
the transport routes, then draw 
power from the crowded habitats!

A guest at the party upstairs
works with the visiting envoys.
Their towns are losing shipments
too. Show the host our evidence.
stages.repeatText: The party host is collecting the\nvisiting envoys' reports. Show\f\nthem the coil and shipment ledger.
stages.blockedText:

stages.title: Embassy party
pages:
Host: These reports came from
four regions beyond the main roads.
Empty nests. Closed freight locks.
Pokemon arriving far from home.

The shipment ledger and that coil
connect every report to Plasma.
They are taking over the transport
and habitat network to force 
migration and harvest its energy.

I have marked the service passage
on your waterway map. Enter the 
Castelia Sewers and follow the 
old freight signs.

Keep helping Hugh and Burgh. Their
investigation matters too.
Beyond that passage, ask each town
what has changed. Alder is helping 
the families. N is listening to 
the Pokemon they left behind.
stages.repeatText:
The service passage in Castelia
Sewers leads to the old network.
The towns need their routes back.
Follow the freight signs.

championTextChanges.after: I was just reminded of Iris.\r\nYes, the former Champion.\nThat Iris...\r
championTextChanges.reason: Keep Iris history while identifying her as the former Champion.

championTextChanges.after: N: Welcome. I can hear your partners.\nThey trust the path you chose.\r
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after: I have been looking forward to\nmeeting them here.\r
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after:
N: Once, I believed that separating
people and Pokemon would free them.
But a voice is not free if someone
else decides what it must say.
In those towns, you listened.
Then you and your partners acted.
Now let me hear your answer in battle.
I am N, Champion of Unova!
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after:
N: Our partners have changed
since we last stood here.
There is no final answer to
understanding one another.
Show me the path you have taken.
Let us battle again!
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after:
N: I heard them clearly.
They chose to give you everything.
I am glad I could meet a team
with such a strong bond.
Come. There is a place where
we can remember this moment.
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after: This way. Your partners deserve\nto stand beside you.\r
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after: Take your time. I will be here\nwhen you and your partners are ready.\r
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after:
N: This is the Hall of Fame.
It records the names of a Trainer
and the Pokemon who stood together.
The journey belongs to all of you.
No one could have walked it alone.
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

championTextChanges.after:
N: Welcome back to the Hall of Fame.
New battles, new choices...
And the trust that brought you here.
Let us record this chapter
of your journey together.
championTextChanges.reason: Current Champion N and Hall of Fame identity; preserve other Iris scenes.

To the Trainer before me,
and to every Pokemon at your side...
You chose this journey together.
May these names remind us of that.
